columns.delivery_pct: delivery % (previous session; NaN if that session was BE/BZ)
columns.avg_delivery_pct_20d: delivery % 20d avg (previous session; NaN if any BE/BZ row in the window)
columns.delivery_pct_vs_20d: delivery % vs its 20d avg (previous session; NaN if any BE/BZ row in the window)
columns.log_mcap: log10 market cap (Rs cr; PIT only where mcap_source == pnl_implied)
columns.age_yrs: years since first panel row, only for names first seen after the panel start (NaN = listed before 2015); never a model feature
columns.profitable: TTM EPS > 0 (four quarters on one basis, con preferred, else sa)
columns.pe: PE: then-traded price / TTM EPS on the share basis in force at t (NaN if TTM EPS <= 0)
columns.eps_yoy: latest reported quarter EPS YoY vs the same calendar quarter a year earlier, both on one basis (con preferred, else sa), present share basis
columns.sales_yoy: latest reported quarter sales YoY vs the same calendar quarter a year earlier, both on one basis (con preferred, else sa)
columns.loss_to_profit: latest reported quarter profit after a year-ago loss, one basis (NaN if the year-ago quarter is unknown on that basis)
columns.days_since_results: days since the session the latest quarter's results first became known (either basis)
columns.ev60_open_offer_target: 'open_offer_target' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_tender_L1: 'tender_L1' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_order: 'order' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_client_partner: 'client_partner' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_acquisition: 'acquisition' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_approval_launch: 'approval_launch' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_capex: 'capex' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_fundraise_pref: 'fundraise_pref' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_fundraise_qip: 'fundraise_qip' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_buyback: 'buyback' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_rating_up: 'rating_up' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.ev60_bonus_split: 'bonus_split' filings in last 60d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.filings30_all: all filings last 30d (NaN outside announcement coverage)
columns.last_order_to_rev_90d: most recent order/L1 filing within 90d: order value / TTM revenue (NaN = none)
columns.prom_buys90: promoter PIT 'Market Purchase' disclosures, 90d (NaN outside PIT coverage)
columns.prom_sells90: promoter PIT 'Market Sale' disclosures, 90d (NaN outside PIT coverage)
columns.prom_delta: promoter holding change vs the previous calendar quarter (pp)
columns.mkt_breadth: share of core-band stocks above 50DMA (same-day close)
columns.mkt_ew_ret60: MEDIAN stock 60d return, mcap>=50cr (EW mean before the 2026-09-27 audit fix; name kept)
columns.y95: 1 if max high over the next 95 sessions (global calendar) >= 1.5x entry close; NaN if the window passes the panel end
columns.fc95: close at +95 sessions / close (frozen at the last close if delisted)
columns.pred: walk-forward LightGBM out-of-sample P(y95) (first test year onward)
columns.close: back-adjusted close (returns only; use rows_audit.close_raw for levels)
columns.mcap_source: pnl_implied = PIT shares; screener_backcast / screener_backfill = present shares x price (NOT point-in-time)

units: returns/ratios are fractions; mcap_cr, adv in Rs crore; delivery_pct as in the panel
caveats: mcap is PIT only where rows_audit.mcap_source == pnl_implied
industry is one 2026 screener label applied to all years (not PIT)
labels on windows with missing sessions are lower bounds (rows_audit.label_obs95 < 95)

sessions = panel dates minus non-session dates (NSE holidays whose rows copy the previous session; results.json non_session_dates_dropped); panel-computed rolling columns (sma_50/200, avg_traded_value_20d, volume_vs_*, traded_value_vs_60d, rsi_14_*, avg_delivery_pct_20d, delivery_pct_vs_20d) still include those copied rows
'features' = the columns the anatomy model used (coverage rule); other feature columns are Part 1 only
